name: polish-screenshot
description: Local, non-generative screenshot redaction and deterministic composition for publication-ready visuals.

interface.shortDescription: Redact and polish screenshots entirely locally.
interface.longDescription: Edits original screenshot pixels with visually verified blur, pixelation, or solid privacy masks, then frames captures with deterministic backgrounds, balanced padding, rounded corners, and soft shadows entirely on the local machine.
interface.defaultPrompt: Redact only the areas I identify, visually verify the result, and polish this screenshot for publication.
